purpose: Chemist-style group library for SMARTS templating with attachment points (context groups like 'Ar-' and core groups like '-CHO').
notes: Use group.id for stable references in code; use group.name for chemist-facing display (e.g., 'Ar-', '-CHO').
Not every traditional functional group is best represented as a two-piece template; complex/multi-attachment motifs can remain atomic SMARTS features.
Tail groups (e.g., -OTf) are meant to be used with an O-linker template.

groups.name: Ar-
groups.description: Aryl attachment via aromatic carbon (covers most heteroaryl attachments when the connection is through aromatic carbon).

groups.name: Arom-
groups.description: Any aromatic atom attachment (broader than Ar-; includes attachment via aromatic hetero atoms).

groups.name: Vinyl-
groups.description: Vinylic (alkenyl) attachment at an sp2 carbon.

groups.name: Alkynyl-
groups.description: Alkynyl attachment at a carbon in a C#C unit (general; may match internal/terminal).

groups.name: R-
groups.description: Alkyl (sp3 carbon) attachment point.

groups.name: Bn-
groups.description: Benzylic methylene attachment (–CH2–Ar).

groups.name: Allyl-
groups.description: Allylic CH2 attachment (simple allyl motif).

groups.name: -Cl
groups.description: Chloride atom (typically used with context templates, e.g., Ar- + -Cl).

groups.name: -Br
groups.description: Bromide atom.

groups.name: -I
groups.description: Iodide atom.

groups.name: -F
groups.description: Fluoride atom.

groups.name: -CHO
groups.description: Aldehyde core; attachment via formyl carbon.

groups.name: -CN
groups.description: Nitrile (cyano) group; attachment via cyano carbon.

groups.name: -NO2
groups.description: Nitro group; attachment via nitro nitrogen.

groups.name: -OH
groups.description: Hydroxy group; attachment via oxygen.

groups.name: -OR
groups.description: Alkoxy substituent motif (ether-like); attachment via oxygen.

groups.name: -NH2
groups.description: Primary amine; attachment via nitrogen.

groups.name: -NHR
groups.description: Secondary amine (has one N–H).

groups.name: -NR2
groups.description: Tertiary amine (no N–H).

groups.name: -SH
groups.description: Thiol; attachment via sulfur.

groups.name: -SR
groups.description: Thioether substituent motif; attachment via sulfur.

groups.name: -CO2H
groups.description: Carboxylic acid substituent; attachment via carbonyl carbon.

groups.name: -CO2R
groups.description: Carboxylic ester substituent; attachment via carbonyl carbon.

groups.name: -CONH2
groups.description: Primary amide substituent; attachment via carbonyl carbon.

groups.name: -CONHR
groups.description: Secondary amide substituent (has N–H); attachment via carbonyl carbon.

groups.name: -CONR2
groups.description: Tertiary amide substituent; attachment via carbonyl carbon.

groups.name: -COCl
groups.description: Acyl chloride functional group; attachment via carbonyl carbon.

groups.name: -B(OH)2
groups.description: Boronic acid substituent; attachment via boron.

groups.name: -Bpin
groups.description: Pinacol boronate (Bpin) substituent; attachment via boron.

groups.name: -OTf
groups.description: Triflate tail; used with template: (context)O + tail.

groups.name: -OTs
groups.description: Tosylate tail; used with template: (context)O + tail.

groups.name: -OMs
groups.description: Mesylate tail; used with template: (context)O + tail.

groups.name: -OAc
groups.description: Acetate tail; used with template: (context)O + tail (acetate ester).

single_bond.description: Concatenate two fragments to represent a single-bond connection between attachment atom in A and the start of B.

via_oxygen.description: Attach B through an oxygen linker (useful for sulfonates/pseudohalides and alkoxy derivatives).
